messages:
maya.f: Heads up — customer 'Vertex Labs' reported their March invoice (INV-2026-0321) missing reserved GPU commitment line and support credit applied twice. PDF attached. Anyone seeing this in the batch?

invoice-bot: billing-batch after-run: job 8765 completed; 1 warning(s). See /batches/8765

raj: looking. Which export did they use? Is this hosted or dedicated?

maya.f: Hosted. They showed invoice PDF and CSV. In PDF line items: compute $1,234.56, support credit -$50 applied twice, reserved-commitment line missing. CSV shows two rows for INV-2026-0321 with different amounts.

maya.f: ```
invoice_number,customer_id,line_code,amount
INV-2026-0321,VERTEX-17,COMPUTE,1234.56
INV-2026-0321,VERTEX-17,SUPPORT_CREDIT,-50.00
INV-2026-0321,vertex-17,SUPPORT_CREDIT,-50.00
```

raj: Can you drop the CSV snippet and the full batch id? I'll grep.

maya.f: s3://billing-prod/batches/8765/invoices/INV-2026-0321.pdf and invoices_2026-03-31.csv (batch id 8765).

raj: found in export: duplicate invoice id 2026-0321 in export file invoices_2026-03-31.csv. Looks like our dedupe key was invoice_number+customer_id but we had different customer_id casing. grabbing logs.

raj: ```
2026-03-31T04:12:03Z INFO generate_invoice invoice=INV-2026-0321 customer_id=VERTEX-17
2026-03-31T04:12:03Z INFO generate_invoice invoice=INV-2026-0321 customer_id=vertex-17
```

olivia: If invoice was duplicated in CSV, did we run reissue flow? We must void duplicates before sending. What's the impact on revenue recognition?

dennis: Vertex is getting two PDFs; they're confused. Customer requested immediate corrected PDF. Can finance reissue?

raj: I see root cause: when we applied commitment credits, they are stored as separate line with item_code 'commit_credit_v2' but our PDF merge only looks for 'commit_credit'. So line omitted and a fallback produced a negative support credit twice (bug in mapping). I'll open PR to mapping code: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/1427

maya.f: Thanks. Can we hotfix the mapping and re-run batch 8765 with --force-regen-invoices? Also, patch to dedupe logic to normalize customer_id lowercase.

invoice-bot: billing-batch-processor: rerun requested by raj; new job 8765-rerun-1 queued.

raj: Will monitor. I'll push patch and coordinate reissue.

olivia: Put a note on the accounting ledger; I'll hold recognition until corrected. Tag me when reissue done.

dennis: I'll reply to Vertex with ETA and attach single corrected PDF once ready. thx :pray:
